name: codex-coordination
description: A durable AMP coordination ledger for Codex: goals with observable success criteria, bounded plans, accountable handoffs, and a hash-chained audit trail, exposed as five MCP tools and four skills.

interface.longDescription: Coordination gives Codex a durable ledger beside the repository: goals that name an observable outcome, plans of at most twelve dependency-checked tasks, handoffs between a declared owner and assignee, and a SHA-256 chained journal of every change. The five MCP tools record assertions and enforce the protocol's structure; they never pretend to run your checks or prove your evidence.
defaultPrompt: Check the coordination ledger for this repository and tell me what is still open
Record this outcome as a goal with observable success criteria, then plan the steps
Audit the coordination ledger and repair anything inconsistent
